title: Projektetage Resize Handles Alignment
description: Fix interactive resize on projektetage: content scales uniformly inside the frame (no text reflow overshoot); resize handles aligned with selection chrome.
summary:
Resize handles on positioned projektetage slides now track the selected figure background.

- Pinned non-uniform resize already scaled content uniformly; selection chrome now gets the same `scale()` so eight handles sit on the highlight corners instead of inside the full wrapper.
- Drag, resize, and marquee use arrangement-canvas normalized coordinates (not the larger flex-centered section).
- Added helpers/tests; all 44 `@framework/presentation/renderer/react` tests pass.
